providers.reason: Fenice can reach the authorized Directa/Darwin API path, but the separate realtime/historical datafeed entitlement is not enabled. Exact-MIC realtime evidence is therefore not available from Directa today.

Official EODHD EU WebSockets provide realtime European trades/quotes sourced from Cboe Europe across 18 home markets, with quotes consolidated across BXE/CXE/DXE. Useful as an independent realtime cross-check, but not exact primary-MIC evidence for Xetra/Milan/Euronext listings and paid-token/use-right evidence is still required.

Cboe Europe offers realtime Top/Last Sale/depth feeds, pan-European coverage and trials. Automated Fenice use is Non-Display under the 2026 policy, so a free trial or retail display waiver alone cannot unlock PAPER; exact venue/instrument mapping plus explicit Non-Display entitlement evidence is required.

Cboe publishes MiFID public trade CSV files free of charge with no more than 15-minute delay and minute files for recent data. This is lawful and useful for independent sanity checks, but delayed data can never satisfy Fenice realtime PAPER quorum.

Deutsche Boerse documents a cloud WebSocket realtime feed and 30-day free access. Current published Cloud Stream product scope includes Xetra ETFs/ETPs, selected Eurex products, Tradegate BSX, DBDX and 360T, not a blanket entitlement to Xetra equities. PAPER requires exact product/MIC mapping and explicit automated/non-display usage rights.

dxFeed offers realtime EU equities and exchange-sourced feeds including Cboe Europe, gettex and Tradegate. PAPER requires commercial entitlement, explicit automated-use rights and exact source/venue mapping.
IBKR Web API supports streaming Level 1 data and exchange-specific conId@EXCHANGE requests. Most securities require market-data subscriptions and no authorized IBKR account is connected to Fenice.
Saxo OpenAPI supports realtime streaming quotes, but market-data access requires an authorized account/token and applicable data terms.

Deutsche Boerse distributes exact Xetra realtime data through CEF direct feeds and data vendors. This remains the stronger exact-XETR route for equities, but applicable data entitlement/non-display rights must be documented before PAPER.

Euronext realtime data is available by direct feed/Stream API or redistributor. Euronext explicitly distinguishes Display from Non-Display application/algorithm use; exact venue data can be PAPER-eligible only after the applicable entitlement is documented.

Twelve Data documents licensed Cboe Europe realtime coverage at MIC BCXE via a data add-on. This can become exact Cboe-venue evidence if the account entitlement and automated-use rights are proven, but it must not be mislabeled as exact XETR/XMIL/XPAR home-venue evidence.
International realtime stock quotes require separately verified enterprise market-data entitlement; no such entitlement is persisted in Fenice.
Free service is end-of-day and current public intraday positioning does not establish exact-venue international realtime entitlement for Fenice.
Public cross-check only; never satisfies PAPER quorum.
